import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Check current .env files
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cat /opt/areloria/client/.env 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("3D .env:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cat /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/.env 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("\n2D .env:", stdout.read().decode())
# Ensure server URL is configurable via environment
# Add VITE_ prefix for Vite environment variables
c.exec_command("""echo '
# Server Configuration
# Override these in your environment or CI/CD
VITE_SERVER_URL=https://arelorian.de
VITE_WS_URL=wss://arelorian.de/ws
' >> /opt/areloria/client/.env""")
c.exec_command("""echo '
# Server Configuration
VITE_SERVER_URL=https://arelorian.de
VITE_WS_URL=wss://arelorian.de/ws
' > /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/.env""")
print("\n✅ Environment configs updated!")
# List all created files
c.exec_command("ls -laR /opt/areloria/packages/core-network/")
c.exec_command("ls -laR /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/")
c.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/client/src/networking/sharedNetwork.ts")
c.close()
EOF
